description.zh-Hans: 中文桌的台词说地道中文：英文原文的「简短、干脆」是态度不是句号，关系紧的话用逗号连着说，用语气词带出口气，少用书面词、公文腔和翻译腔；口吻卡的示例问答也按中文习惯写。只改说法，不改事实和立场。
description.en: Chinese tables speak Chinese: a book's clipped or curt speaker is a manner, not a row of full stops; related points run on with commas, particles carry the tone, and written, official or translated phrasing stays out; voice cards' sample exchanges are written the Chinese way. Wording only; facts and positions do not change.
